label: miso23 cc-minload-premium
definition: Offer-SHAPE faithfulness fix on top of miso22 (all miso22/miso21 levers retained): correct the CC_REGULAR committed (min-stable-load) band 0.92 -> 1.20 to the measured CAMPD part-load premium (a CC's min-load $/MWh is ~30-40% above full-load SRMC), so the min-load tranche prices ABOVE the full-load body (committed > econ_high > econ_low) instead of below it; capped just under the ST_GAS non-inversion ceiling (1.227). METRIC-NEUTRAL vs miso22 (gmModel CC_REGULAR -1.5/-0.8/-0.9 TWh, the right direction on the over-run; ST_GAS / CT_PEAKER / coal / prices all <0.5 TWh / <$0.1/MWh): the committed band is a must-run min-load PRICE block whose volume is set by commitment, so it corrects merit ORDER without moving volume. Determination NOT-YET (unchanged C1/C2 misses): the CC-over/CT-under substitution is NOT offer-curve-addressable (CC excess is in its measured-flat econ body; CT deficit is gated by the missing scarcity mechanism + the 2024/25 import under-run -- separate root causes). Keeper on faithfulness grounds (correct min-load offer ordering), not on a fit gain.
